{{Quote|You should create a food processing center near your muja fruit bushes.|Qui-Gon Jinn to the Wookiees|audio=MeWantFood.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Foodsources.jpg|thumb|Food Processing Center.]]
The '''Food Processing Center''' was a type of building used for processing and packaging edible plant and animal products. Typically, the food processed in these structures is harvested nearby by workers - often [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] - from such sources as [[Farm/Legends|farms]], [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] bushes, or animals such as [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] or [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]]. During the [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] food processing centers were built by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] workers.

==Behind the scenes==
Food Processing Centers serve as resource drop-off buildings in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]].
